# Reviewed outbound endpoints for source-bearing jobs.
#
# Format: one entry per line, "<scope> <pattern>  # reason". The reason is required.
#   scope    all, or one workflow family: linux, macos, windows, android, ios,
#            orchestrate, keeldock, live
#   pattern  an exact host name, or "*.suffix" for any subdomain of suffix (not suffix itself)
#
# Two uses:
#   1. Audit (now): the egress-audit composite publishes a queried host name only when it
#      matches an entry here. Every other name is published as a count and a truncated
#      SHA-256, so internal, customer or exfiltration-shaped names never reach a public log.
#   2. Block (Linux, later): the per-family entries become the enforced allow-list.
# Wildcards on shared storage (*.blob.core.windows.net, *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com) are
# exfiltration-capable; they are listed because the runner and registries depend on them,
# and are the documented residual of block mode.
#
# Checked by .github/policy/check-egress-allowlist.sh.

# --- GitHub and the Actions runner service -------------------------------------------
all github.com                                  # public and private checkouts, release downloads
all api.github.com                              # token mint, identity and SHA checks, revoke
all codeload.github.com                         # archive downloads of pinned releases
all *.githubusercontent.com                     # release assets, raw files, container bottles
all *.actions.githubusercontent.com             # runner service: logs, results, cache API
all githubapp.com                               # runner service apex
all *.githubapp.com                             # hosted compute orchestrator and watchdog
all ghcr.io                                     # GitHub container registry (Homebrew bottles)
all *.blob.core.windows.net                     # Actions cache and results storage
all *.servicebus.windows.net                    # runner broker
all *.github.com                                # GitHub service subdomains (uploads, pipelines)

# --- CDN names returned as CNAME targets of the hosts below -----------------------------
all *.fastly.net                                # crates.io, rust-lang.org, npm and PyPI CDN
all *.cloudfront.net                            # static.crates.io CDN
all *.akamaiedge.net                            # Microsoft and Apple CDN
all *.akamai.net                                # Microsoft and Apple CDN
all *.edgekey.net                               # Microsoft and Apple CDN
all *.edgesuite.net                             # Microsoft and Apple CDN
all *.azureedge.net                             # Microsoft CDN (dotnet, Playwright)
all *.azurefd.net                               # Azure Front Door (Microsoft downloads)
all *.trafficmanager.net                        # Azure Traffic Manager CNAMEs
all *.cloudflare.net                            # Cloudflare CNAMEs (npm, Docker Hub)

# --- Rust ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
all static.rust-lang.org                        # rustup toolchains and components
all fastly-static.rust-lang.org                 # static.rust-lang.org CDN name
all index.crates.io                             # sparse registry index
all static.crates.io                            # crate archives
all crates.io                                   # registry API

# --- JavaScript ------------------------------------------------------------------------
all registry.npmjs.org                          # npm ci from the lock files
all nodejs.org                                  # setup-node fallback download
linux playwright.azureedge.net                  # Playwright browser download
linux cdn.playwright.dev                        # Playwright browser download
linux playwright.download.prss.microsoft.com    # Playwright browser download

# --- Operating-system packages ---------------------------------------------------------
all azure.archive.ubuntu.com                    # apt on hosted Ubuntu (Linux, Android, live)
all archive.ubuntu.com                          # apt fallback mirror
all security.ubuntu.com                         # apt security pocket
all packages.microsoft.com                      # apt repository preconfigured on the image
all formulae.brew.sh                            # Homebrew metadata (macOS, iOS)

# --- Android ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
android dl.google.com                           # pinned command-line tools, SDK packages
android maven.google.com                        # Android Gradle plugin and AndroidX
android dl-ssl.google.com                       # SDK manager repository
android repo.maven.apache.org                   # Maven Central
android repo1.maven.org                         # Maven Central
android services.gradle.org                     # Gradle distribution
android downloads.gradle.org                    # Gradle distribution CDN
android plugins.gradle.org                      # Gradle plugin portal
android plugins-artifacts.gradle.org            # Gradle plugin portal artifacts

# --- .NET (Keel Dock) ------------------------------------------------------------------
keeldock api.nuget.org                          # NuGet restore from the lock files
keeldock globalcdn.nuget.org                    # NuGet package CDN
keeldock builds.dotnet.microsoft.com            # setup-dotnet SDK download
keeldock dotnetcli.azureedge.net                # setup-dotnet SDK download (legacy feed)
keeldock aka.ms                                 # setup-dotnet redirects

# --- Container registries (live proofs, Keel Dock PostgreSQL) ----------------------------
live registry-1.docker.io                       # Docker Hub (RocketMQ, Doris, StarRocks, Informix)
live auth.docker.io                             # Docker Hub token service
live production.cloudflare.docker.com           # Docker Hub layer CDN
live *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com                 # Docker Hub layer storage
live mcr.microsoft.com                          # SQL Server images
live *.data.mcr.microsoft.com                   # SQL Server image layers
live icr.io                                     # IBM Db2 Community image
live containers.intersystems.com                # InterSystems IRIS Community image
keeldock registry-1.docker.io                   # PostgreSQL for the Migrator proof
keeldock auth.docker.io                         # Docker Hub token service
keeldock production.cloudflare.docker.com       # Docker Hub layer CDN
keeldock *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com             # Docker Hub layer storage
